# tools: add dsq

Add [dsq](https://github.com/multiprocessio/dsq) to the Go toolset. **Motivation:** an alternative to `octosql` ([#97](DOT-96.md)) for the "SQL for everything" experiments — dsq runs SQL over CSV, JSON, Parquet, Excel and logs via an embedded SQLite.
